voltage.label: Voltage
voltage.note: Red above 110 V + 10%. Ask Abolfazl whether low voltage (e.g. below 99 V) should also be red.

current.label: Current
current.note: Green below 10 A - 10%, red above 10 A + 10%, yellow in between.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.note: PLACEHOLDER - get the real operating temperature and overheat limit from Abolfazl.
